full_judgment: 4. It is at this juncture that the Pre-emptee-Petitioner puts this Court on notice of the history of the two rounds of proceedings and cases stemming from Miscellaneous Case No. 45 of 1987 and culminating in the impugned judgment and order dated 31.3.1997 in Miscellaneous Appeal No. 70 of 1994. The matter at issue now, however, according to the Pre-emptee-Petitioner is given that the provisions of Section 96 of State Acquisition and Tenancy Act, 1950 (hereinafter referred to as the 'Act') mandates that a pre-emptor must make parties of co-sharer tenants of holdings and tenancies contiguous to the land transferred, the Pre-emptor's case has from the very beginning been marked by a defect of non-joinder or non-addition of such parties, and the lower appellate court having at the very last stage failed to appropriately determine that matter on the basis of facts and evidence before it, the judgment and order in Miscellaneous Appeal No. 70 of 1994 is now liable to be set aside.
